summary: Scheduling, patient records and treatment tracking automated into one compliant platform.
challenge: A fertility consultancy was running appointments, patient records and treatment tracking by hand, which does not scale and carries real privacy risk.
approach: Built a web platform covering appointment scheduling, patient data and treatment tracking in one place, with the manual steps automated out.
Designed data handling around security and privacy compliance from the start, then tested the flows end to end before going live.
metaTitle: Case Study: South African fertility consultancy | TDM
metaDescription: Scheduling, patient records and treatment tracking automated into one compliant platform.
